operations.label: Clear All Button
operations.summary: "Clear All" button — reset the whole import form including the attached file.

operations.label: Clear Keywords Button
operations.summary: "Clear Keywords" button — reset keyword fields without losing the attached file.

operations.label: Set Document Name constant (keyset never fills this field)
operations.summary: The Document Name keyword textbox — the one required field the Employee Lookup keyset does NOT autofill.
operations.note: Must be set manually with the per-doc-type constant (e.g. 'EMERGENCY CONTACT INFORMATION' for X_HR_Emergency Contact). Required ('red') field — Import button stays disabled until populated.

operations.label: Document Name Input — Scrape
operations.summary: Read the current value of the Document Name keyword textbox.

operations.label: Document Type Groups — Scrape
operations.summary: Read the currently selected document type group from the combobox.

operations.label: Document Type Groups — Select
operations.summary: "Document Type Groups" combobox — pick <All>, Payroll Records, or Personnel Records.
operations.note: Drive with .selectOption({ label }). Filters the Document Types dropdown.

operations.label: Document Types — Scrape
operations.summary: Read the currently selected X_HR_* document type from the combobox.

operations.label: Select Document Type
operations.summary: "Document Types" combobox — pick the X_HR_* type (e.g. X_HR_Emergency Contact).
operations.note: Must be set before typing UCPath ID + Tab so the Employee Lookup keyset fires with the correct document type context.

operations.label: Attach person's single-page PDF via file picker (in-memory bytes)
operations.summary: Hidden <input type=file> behind the "Choose File" button. Drive with .setInputFiles(path).
operations.note: File name is {ucpathId}-p{sourcePage}.pdf; uses setInputFiles with in-memory Buffer — no temp file

operations.label: File Type — Scrape
operations.summary: Read the currently selected file type from the combobox.

operations.label: Select File Type: PDF (.pdf)
operations.summary: "File Type" combobox — pick PDF (.pdf); defaults to Image File Format.
operations.note: Always select 'PDF (.pdf)' explicitly — default is Image File Format which is incorrect for HR docs.

operations.label: Import Document Iframe
operations.summary: The Import Document iframe (FileUploadEnhanced.aspx). Resolve once, then pass the FrameLocator to the field selectors below.
operations.note: Returns a FrameLocator, not a Locator; used to scope all importForm field selectors. Not a user-visible element — emit as scrape to represent 'enter/read the iframe context'.

operations.label: Assert Import button is enabled before clicking
operations.summary: isImportEnabled() calls .isEnabled() on the Import button; throws if false — refuses to import when the form is not ready

operations.label: Click Import button to submit the document
operations.summary: The "Import" submit button — disabled until a file and all required keywords are present.
operations.note: Gate on isImportEnabled() before clicking — commits a real document to OnBase. Never click in a dry run.

operations.label: Apply Keyset Button
operations.summary: Apply-keyset (key icon) button beside the Keyset Lookup select.
operations.note: Accessible name matches the adjacent select ('Keyset Lookup') — both share the label. Click after selecting the keyset to arm it.

operations.label: Read current Keyset Lookup value (idempotent check)
operations.summary: Read the currently selected keyset from the combobox.
operations.note: ensureKeyset reads inputValue; skips the selectOption call if already set to Employee Lookup

operations.label: Select Keyset Lookup: Employee Lookup (if not already set)
operations.summary: "Keyset Lookup" combobox — pick 'Employee Lookup' to enable UCPath ID autofill.
operations.note: Must be set before clicking keysetApplyButton; 'Employee Lookup' autofills all keywords except Document Name when UCPath ID + Tab is fired.

operations.label: Fallback fill: Department Code (dataset combobox)
operations.note: Executed only if keysetAutofilled=false and value is non-empty

operations.label: Fallback fill: Department Name (dataset combobox)
operations.note: Executed only if keysetAutofilled=false and value is non-empty

operations.label: Fallback fill: Vice Chancellor (dataset combobox)
operations.note: Executed only if keysetAutofilled=false and value is non-empty

operations.label: Fallback fill: Vice Chancellor Code (dataset combobox)
operations.note: Executed only if keysetAutofilled=false and value is non-empty

operations.label: Keyword Combobox (Dataset-backed) — Scrape
operations.summary: Read a dataset-backed keyword value by OnBase label — e.g. verify keyset populated Department Name.
operations.note: Parameterized: second arg `label` matches the OnBase keyword label exactly.

operations.label: Read Department Code combobox value (required keyword verification)
Read Department Name combobox value (required keyword verification)
Read Vice Chancellor combobox value (required keyword verification)
Read Vice Chancellor Code combobox value (required keyword verification)
Keyword Combobox (Dataset-backed) — Select
operations.summary: Generic dataset-backed keyword combobox by OnBase label (Department Name, Department Code, Vice Chancellor, Vice Chancellor Code).
operations.note: Parameterized: second arg `label` matches the OnBase keyword label exactly. These fields are comboboxes (dataset-backed), not plain textboxes — use selectOption or appropriate Playwright combobox fill, not .fill().

operations.label: Keyword Textbox (Generic) — Fill
operations.summary: Generic keyword textbox by OnBase label (e.g. 'Last Name', 'First Name', 'Middle Name', 'Suffix', 'Document Name').
operations.note: Parameterized: second arg `label` matches the OnBase keyword label exactly (exact: true). Use concrete selectors (ucpathIdInput, documentNameInput) for the primary key and Document Name; use this for all other text keywords autofilled by the keyset.

operations.label: Fallback fill: First Name
operations.note: Executed only if keysetAutofilled=false and value is non-empty

operations.label: Fallback fill: Last Name
operations.note: Executed only if keysetAutofilled=false and value is non-empty

operations.label: Fallback fill: Middle Name
operations.note: Executed only if keysetAutofilled=false and value is non-empty

operations.label: Fallback fill: Suffix
operations.note: Executed only if keysetAutofilled=false and value is non-empty

operations.label: Keyword Textbox (Generic) — Scrape
operations.summary: Read a keyword value by OnBase label — useful to verify keyset autofill results.
operations.note: Parameterized: second arg `label` matches the OnBase keyword label exactly (exact: true).

operations.label: Read Document Name keyword value (required keyword verification)
Read First Name keyword value (required keyword verification)
Read Last Name keyword value (required keyword verification)
Poll Last Name field until non-empty (keyset autofill confirmation)
operations.note: Polls inputValue every 500ms up to 12s (label 'Last Name'); returns true if populated (keyset fired), false if timeout (triggers fallback fill branch)

operations.label: Read UCPath ID keyword value (required keyword verification)
Fill UCPath ID keyword field
operations.summary: The UCPath ID keyword textbox — the primary key; type it + Tab to fire the Employee Lookup keyset autofill.
operations.note: After filling, press Tab to trigger the Employee Lookup keyset — autofills all keywords except Document Name. If the keyset does not populate (unknown UCPath ID), fill required keywords manually from OCR/person-lookup data.

operations.label: UCPath ID Input — Scrape
operations.summary: Read the current value of the UCPath ID keyword textbox.

operations.label: Wait for Import Document form ready (UCPath ID field visible)
operations.note: waitFor state:visible, timeout:15000ms — confirms the NavPanelIFrame iframe rendered

operations.label: Document Retrieval Menu Item
operations.summary: "Document Retrieval" item in the Main Menu Document group (search screen).

operations.label: Click Import Document menu item
operations.summary: "Import Document" item in the Main Menu Document group.

operations.label: Click nine-squares Main Menu launcher
operations.summary: Nine-squares "Main Menu" launcher in the top banner.
operations.note: Role is 'navigation' (a nav landmark), not 'button'; click it to reveal the Main Menu panel.

operations.label: Wait for network idle after import submission
operations.summary: page.waitForLoadState('networkidle', {timeout:15000}); error is swallowed with .catch(()=>{}) — best-effort settle
